facts_carried_forward: SCN-05 is the Accessible route copilot in Beijing AI Origin Community
the geometry is a medium-confidence design proposal pending official material and field confirmation
the accountable roles are an authorized public-space maintainer and an accessibility reviewer, both to be appointed before activation
the no-AI state is tactile mapping plus human directions
an unverified route, a new break or a user objection keeps or returns the smart layer to off

limitations: Passing JSON Schema validation proves only that the two files are syntactically valid and that the example conforms to the declared data contract.
The validation does not establish route continuity, accessibility quality, model accuracy, operational safety, legal compliance, public acceptance or authorization by any competent body.
The SCN-05 point and operating extent remain conceptual until official material and field investigation confirm them.
Both control roles are unassigned concept roles; the refusal is a protocol-default safe state, not an official human or government decision.
Performance results and rollback observations are intentionally null because no field test or rehearsal was executed.
The example uses synthetic conditions, contains no personal data and connects to no live public service.
scope_notice: 本报告只证明三对 schema 与实例可被机器解析、互相引用完整、baseline 与 target 仍为 null。它不证明任何角色已被任命、任何指标已有数值、任何场景已运行或任何做法已获许可。role-spec.json 与 measurement-protocol.json 均为未执行、未授权的规格文件。
